claims: Coachella sets typically last 45 to 55 minutes for most artists.
Coachella headliners usually perform for 1.5 to 2 hours.
Coachella earlier acts may play for 30–40 minutes.
Special performances such as those on the Quasar stage at Coachella can last 3–4 hours.
Coachella sets generally run until 1 a.m. on Friday/Saturday and midnight on Sunday.
Coachella sub-headliners/Main Stage acts perform for 60–75 minutes.
Coachella other artists perform for 45–55 minutes.
Coachella Quasar Stage sets last 3–4 hours.
